definitions.explanation: For water or liquid to reach boiling temperature.

definitions.gloss: to well up, to spring up
definitions.explanation: For emotions, ideas, or enthusiasm to arise.

examples.japanese: {勇気|ゆうき}が{沸|わ}いてきた。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {沸|わ}かす (transitive, to boil). Pattern: Xが{沸|わ}く (X boils).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {沸|わ}いている = 'has boiled' / 'is ready (hot).'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・お{湯|ゆ}が{沸|わ}く (water boils)
・{風呂|ふろ}が{沸|わ}く (bath is ready)
・{勇気|ゆうき}が{沸|わ}く (courage wells up)
・{興味|きょうみ}が{沸|わ}く (interest arises)
・{沸|わ}き{上|あ}がる (surge up)

CONTRAST:
・{沸|わ}く (intransitive): X boils
・{沸|わ}かす (transitive): boil X

FIGURATIVE USAGE: Often used for emotions or mental states that spontaneously arise:
・やる{気|き}が{沸|わ}く (motivation wells up)
・{疑問|ぎもん}が{沸|わ}く (doubt arises)
